_comment: Founder intent only. A goal carries a title, a level, its parent, and the canonical work it maps to. Status and percentage are always derived from objective/task state by factory/lib/hq/goals.mjs — never stored here — so no agent can report a goal complete without delivery evidence. Change goals through a pull request like any other tracked change.

goals.title: Run a software factory the founder can understand and control without reading logs
OpenClaw Agents Headquarter is the canonical operational layer over GitHub delivery
LifeMax runs on a real backend the founder uses daily, privacy-first
